# Fire & Finn

> Takeout hibachi, specialty rolls and build-your-own poke bowls at 2003 Periwinkle Way, Sanibel Island, FL 33957. Formerly Island Panda: same kitchen, same address, new name. Open daily 11am to 8pm. Phone (239) 579-0783. Order online for pickup at https://order.toasttab.com/online/fire-and-finn-2003-periwinkle-way
